integrity: Corrected proof through a convergent primitive p-adic central-binomial unit and isolated large-block multiplication; earlier small-digit factorization had a counterexample and has been superseded.
scientific_limitations: Odd primes with 2 primitive modulo p^2, all p-adic exponents; sufficient not necessary, unknown infinitude and no witness frequency.
title: Catalan residues fill every \(p\)-adic ring when \(2\) is a primitive root
